## Items needing a real boundary case (owner action; I could not edit item text)

1. **`lem-nonequivariance-defect-…-two-cocycle` (batch 13) — confirmed overstrong converse.** "μ coadjoint equivariant iff c = 0" is asserted for arbitrary `G`, but step 4.1 uses [F9], whose converse needs `G` connected (only `M` is assumed connected). Counterexample: `G = Z/2 ⋉ R` acting on `R²` by `(ε,t)·(x,y)=(εx+t, εy)`, `μ=−y+1`: `c ≡ 0` yet `μ((−1,0)·p)=1+y ≠ y−1=(−1,0)·μ(p)`. The `iff-reverse` row records the gap. Fix: add `G` connected, or weaken to equivariance under `G⁰`.
2. **`lem-pmea-three-quarter-separation-estimate` (batch 14) — statement-level qualification.** The conclusion asks for `x ↦ U^x ∈ U_x` on all of `X`, but step 3.1 builds it only on `⋃F_i`; outside the union the hypothesis is vacuous and permits `U_x = ∅`. Fix: require `U_x ≠ ∅` (the intended local-base reading) or restrict the assignment. Recorded in the `degenerate` row.

Both items are **draft**, not published, so no published-consumer-ledger entry is raised (and I did not race that ledger). No local suppliers were added.
